coverage: Windows 11, C++20 and WinUI are classified as changeable accepted product defaults instead of universal safety prohibitions
explicit maintainer requests are valid assignments while agents remain prohibited from self-selecting backlog
non-main branches remain mandatory; dedicated worktrees are mandatory for concurrent, occupied or uncertain state and recommended for a proven single writer
draft PR creation follows the first reproducible WIP/reviewable commit and no rule requires an empty claim commit
always-run validation is limited to scoped handoff, docs, source policy and diff hygiene; doctor, verify, workflow, subsystem and live gates are scope-triggered
directory lanes are routing hints in both MULTI_AGENT and CONFLICT_POLICY; exact scope, semantic contract and shared-path conflicts remain fail-closed
START_HERE replaces a duplicated subsystem status list with pointers to BASELINE, PROJECT_MAP, issue handoff and evidence
driver signing is documented as staged: no Hardware Program account for source/user-space work, explicit test-signing for local or VM development, Microsoft signing for consumer release

limitations: Documentation and repository-process contract only; no product source, build script, driver runtime or release account is changed.
No build, target-machine probe, live audio probe, driver installation or signing action is required by this scope.
